schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Small and Marginal Landholding Farmer Families
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹6,000 per year delivered in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into DBT-linked Aadhaar bank accounts.
eligibility_criteria: Must be an Indian citizen and landholding farmer family with cultivable land in official state land records.
Mandatory Aadhaar e-KYC authentication on pmkisan.gov.in or via OTP / biometric CSC.
Bank account must be seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for NPCI Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

Exclusions: Institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees, pensioners receiving > ₹10,000/month, income-tax payers in the last assessment year, doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects, and constitutional post holders.
benefits: Direct cash transfer of ₹6,000 annually without intermediaries to meet agricultural input costs.
Automatic linkage with PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana and Kisan Credit Card (KCC) concessional loan facility.
documents_required: Land Title Deed / Record of Rights (RoR / Khatauni / Khasra)
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in under 'New Farmer Registration' or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land revenue records.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Farmers, Panchayats, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Water User Associations
schemes.financial_assistance: Up to 60% capital subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for standalone solar pumps and solarisation of existing grid-connected agriculture pumps.
eligibility_criteria: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs, Cooperatives, or Panchayats owning agricultural land.
Beneficiary contributes 10% of benchmark cost, 30% can be availed as bank loan, remaining 60% is subsidized.
benefits: Installation of 7.5 HP to 10 HP solar water pumps replacing diesel pumps.
Daytime uninterrupted irrigation and opportunity to sell surplus solar power back to DISCOMs for extra farm income.
schemes.application_process: Register through State Renewable Energy Development Agencies (SREDAs) or State Agriculture Portals linked to pmkusum.mnre.gov.in.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Farmers Growing Notified Kharif and Rabi Crops
schemes.financial_assistance: Subsidized crop insurance cover with farmers paying only 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; balance shared 50:50 by Central and State Governments.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
Applicable for loanee and non-loanee farmers alike.
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rainfall, pests, landslides, post-harvest cyclone damage).
Direct settlement of claim amount into farmer bank account via National Crop Insurance Portal.
schemes.application_process: Enroll through pmfby.gov.in, nearest bank branch, or CSC within the notified cut-off dates for crop insurance.

schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card Scheme (KCC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Agriculture
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Farmers, Tenant Farmers, Animal Husbandry & Fisheries Farmers
schemes.financial_assistance: Concessional institutional credit up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (7% nominal minus 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive). Collateral-free limit up to ₹1.60 Lakh.
eligibility_criteria: All individual or joint land-owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.
SHGs or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers, dairy farmers, poultry, and fishers.
benefits: ATM-enabled RuPay Kisan Card for flexible cash withdrawal and POS purchase of seeds, fertilizers, and pesticide inputs.
Built-in accidental insurance cover.
schemes.application_process: Apply at any Commercial Bank, RRB, or Cooperative Bank, or online via PM-KISAN portal or Jan Samarth portal.

schemes.title: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Farmers across India
schemes.financial_assistance: Free soil testing and nutrient advisory report issued every 3 years to individual farmers.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers possessing cultivable agricultural land.
benefits: Provides status of 12 soil health parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC).
Recommends customized fertilizer dosages to cut input costs and enhance crop yield.
schemes.application_process: Soil samples are collected by agriculture extension officers or submitted at district Soil Testing Laboratories (STLs). Cards accessible online at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Fishers, Fish Farmers, Fish Workers, Fish Vendors, SHGs, Fisheries Cooperatives
schemes.financial_assistance: Financial assistance with 40% government subsidy for General Category and 60% for SC/ST/Women for aquaculture ponds, biofloc units, RAS, deep-sea fishing vessels, and ice plants.
eligibility_criteria: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, or entrepreneurs engaged in freshwater or brackish water aquaculture or marine fisheries.
Individual or group possessing suitable land or leased water body.
benefits: Capital subsidy for establishing hatcheries, fish feed mills, and refrigerated transport vans.
Insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 against accidental death or permanent disability.
schemes.application_process: Submit project proposal to the District Fisheries Officer (DFO) or apply online through the PMMSY portal at pmmsy.dof.gov.in.

schemes.title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Farmers Groups, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Cluster Farmers
schemes.financial_assistance: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000/ha is directly paid via DBT for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, vermicompost, bio-pesticides).
eligibility_criteria: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 hectares or 50 farmers for certified organic farming.
Must adopt Participatory Guarantee System (PGS-India) certification standards.
benefits: Assistance for PGS-India organic certification, soil sample testing, packaging, and branding organic produce.
Direct linkages to organic trade fairs and e-marketing platforms (Jaivik Kheti portal).
schemes.application_process: Apply through Regional Councils or District Agriculture Department or register on jaivikkheti.in.

schemes.title: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Farmers, Traders, Commission Agents, and FPOs across India
schemes.financial_assistance: Free online pan-India electronic trading platform eliminating middleman commissions, providing transparent price discovery and instant digital payment.
eligibility_criteria: Any farmer holding agricultural produce registered with an e-NAM integrated APMC Mandi.
Traders licensed with Unified Trading License across states.
benefits: Nationwide competitive bidding leading to 10-15% higher realization prices for crops.
Assay-based quality testing facilities available at mandis.
Direct bank transfer of sale proceeds to farmer bank accounts on the same day.
schemes.application_process: Register for free on enam.gov.in or through the e-NAM Mobile App or Mandi registration counter.

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% Vulnerable Families (SECC Deprivation / NFSA) AND All Senior Citizens Aged 70+
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹5,00,000 cashless health insurance cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization. Separate ₹5 Lakh top-up for all individuals aged 70+ irrespective of income.
eligibility_criteria: Deprivation criteria based on SECC 2011 (e.g. D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D7 in rural, designated occupational categories in urban).
Active Ration Card under National Food Security Act (NFSA / Antyodaya Anna Yojana).
Universal 70+ Senior Citizen Expansion: Any Indian citizen aged 70 or older qualifies for an independent Ayushman Vay Vandana Card with ₹5 Lakh cover regardless of income.
benefits: 100% cashless and paperless treatment across 29,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals pan-India.
Covers 1,949 medical and surgical procedures, ICU, implants, 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization medicines.
No restriction on family size, age, or gender; pre-existing conditions covered from Day 1.
documents_required: Ration Card / NFSA Card / Family ID
Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar for OTP verification
schemes.application_process: Self-register on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the 'Ayushman App' via Aadhaar e-KYC, or visit any empanelled hospital 'Ayushman Mitra' desk or CSC.

schemes.title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Residential Households across India
schemes.financial_assistance: Direct Central Subsidy: ₹30,000 for 1 kW system, ₹60,000 for 2 kW system, and ₹78,000 for systems of 3 kW or higher capacity.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an Indian citizen with a valid residential electricity connection in their own name.
Must possess a suitable rooftop or open space with clear solar access.
No previous solar subsidy availed for the same consumer electricity account.
benefits: Up to 300 units of free clean solar electricity per month, drastically lowering electricity bills.
Net-metering allows selling surplus green energy back to the grid for recurring savings.
Low-interest collateral-free loans at ~7% from scheduled commercial banks for the remaining cost.
documents_required: Latest Electricity Bill with Consumer Account Number
schemes.application_process: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in, select your local DISCOM, choose an empanelled vendor, and install system. Subsidy is deposited directly to bank within 30 days of net-meter inspection.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Indian Citizens (Particularly Economically Weaker Sections)
schemes.financial_assistance: Access to high-quality generic medicines, surgical items, and nutraceuticals at 50% to 90% cheaper prices compared to branded market equivalents.
eligibility_criteria: Open universally to all citizens with a valid doctor's prescription for medicines.
Individuals, NGOs, Pharmacists, and Hospitals can also apply for ₹5 Lakh financial incentive to establish Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
benefits: Over 2,047 quality generic medicines and 300 surgical items available across 14,000+ Kendras.
Oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins (Suvidha) available at only ₹1 per pad.
documents_required: Valid Doctor Prescription for purchasing medicines
schemes.application_process: Locate nearest Kendra via 'Jan Aushadhi Sugam' mobile app or janaushadhi.gov.in and purchase directly over the counter.

schemes.title: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (Direct Benefit Transfer for TB Patients)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Notified Tuberculosis (TB) Patients across India
schemes.financial_assistance: Direct cash transfer of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per month for the entire duration of anti-TB treatment to meet nutritional requirements.
eligibility_criteria: All diagnosed TB patients notified on the national Ni-kshay portal (both public and private healthcare sectors).
Must be undergoing active treatment under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP).
benefits: Financial support for high-protein nutritional intake during treatment.
100% free TB diagnostic testing (CBNAAT / TrueNat) and free anti-TB medications.
schemes.application_process: Registration is automatically completed by treating medical officer or health worker on the Nikshay portal (nikshay.in).

schemes.title: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Senior Citizens (Aged 60+) belonging to BPL Category or having Monthly Income < ₹15,000
schemes.financial_assistance: 100% free distribution of assisted living devices and physical aids (wheelchairs, walking sticks, hearing aids, dentures, spectacles, tripod/quadpod).
eligibility_criteria: Senior citizen aged 60 years or above.
Belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category or suffering from age-related physical disabilities/infirmities with monthly income under ₹15,000.
benefits: High quality assistive devices distributed through ALIMCO camps, restoring physical mobility and sensory independence.
schemes.application_process: Enrollment occurs at district assessment camps organized by ALIMCO and District Social Welfare Officers.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Unbanked Indian Citizens (Adults)
schemes.financial_assistance: Zero-balance basic savings bank deposit account (BSBDA) with free RuPay Debit Card, ₹2,00,000 inbuilt accidental insurance cover, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above who does not hold a bank account.
Simplified KYC documents (e-KYC via Aadhaar).
benefits: No minimum balance maintenance requirement and zero account opening charges.
Direct gateway for receiving all Central/State government subsidies and DBT payments.
Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 per eligible household (preferably lady of the house) after 6 months of satisfactory operations.
schemes.application_process: Walk into any public/private commercial bank branch or Bank Mitra / Banking Correspondent (BC) kiosk with Aadhaar card.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Bank / Post Office Savings Account Holders aged 18 to 50 years
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to the nominee upon death of the insured due to any cause.
eligibility_criteria: Indian citizen aged between 18 and 50 years with an active savings bank account or Post Office account.
Consent for auto-debit of annual premium of ₹436 from savings account.
benefits: Guaranteed death benefit of ₹2 Lakh paid to family nominees.
Affordable renewable term life cover with no complex medical checks.
schemes.application_process: Enable auto-debit through Net Banking / Mobile Banking app, or submit PMJJBY consent-cum-declaration form at your bank branch.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Bank / Post Office Savings Account Holders aged 18 to 70 years
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹2,00,000 cover for accidental death or permanent total disability, and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability for an annual premium of only ₹20.
eligibility_criteria: Individual aged between 18 and 70 years with an active savings bank account.
Consent for auto-debit of nominal annual premium of ₹20.
benefits: High-value financial protection against accidental demise or disability at nominal cost of ₹20 per year.
schemes.application_process: Subscribe via Net Banking or submit PMSBY mandate at your home bank branch or Post Office.

schemes.title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Unorganized Sector Workers and Citizens aged 18 to 40 years
schemes.financial_assistance: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 starting at age 60 until lifetime.
eligibility_criteria: Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years with an active savings account.
Must NOT be an income tax payer (as per updated rules from October 1, 2022).
benefits: Government-guaranteed pension to subscriber; same pension continues to spouse upon death; total accumulated corpus returned to nominee.
schemes.application_process: Apply via Net Banking or visit any scheduled commercial bank or post office.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Unorganized Workers (Home-based workers, Street Vendors, Ragpickers, Domestic Workers, Agricultural Workers, Construction Workers)
schemes.financial_assistance: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining the age of 60 years.
eligibility_criteria: Unorganized worker aged 18 to 40 years.
Monthly income must not exceed ₹15,000 per month.
Should not be covered under EPFO, ESIC, NPS, and not an income tax payer.
benefits: 50:50 matching contribution: Beneficiary contributes ₹55 to ₹200 per month depending on entry age, and Central Govt contributes an equal amount.
Family pension of 50% to spouse in case of beneficiary death.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
schemes.application_process: Enroll at nearest CSC with biometric Aadhaar authentication or online at maandhan.in.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMDY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) possessing cultivable land up to 2 hectares
schemes.financial_assistance: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching 60 years of age.
eligibility_criteria: Small and Marginal farmer aged between 18 and 40 years.
Cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares as per land records.
Can auto-contribute directly from PM-KISAN benefits without cash out-of-pocket.
benefits: Equal monthly matching contribution by the Central Government into the Pension Fund managed by LIC.
Life-long financial security for small and marginal cultivators.
schemes.application_process: Enroll online at maandhan.in or visit the nearest Common Services Centre (CSC).

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM)
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹5,000 in two installments for 1st living child, and ₹6,000 in a single installment for 2nd child (if female child) via direct DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Pregnant women and lactating mothers belonging to socially/economically disadvantaged sections (SC/ST, BPL/EWS, NFSA ration card, MGNREGA job card, PM-JAY card, Divyangjan, or women with net family income < ₹8 Lakh).
Exclusions: Women in regular employment with Central/State Govt or PSUs receiving paid maternity benefits.
benefits: Cash incentive compensating for wage loss during pregnancy and childbirth.
Promotes institutional delivery and timely immunization of the newborn.
documents_required: Eligibility Proof (Ration Card / Income Certificate / e-Shram Card)
schemes.application_process: Register on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in or submit PMMVY registration forms at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or Primary Health Centre (PHC).

schemes.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Parents / Legal Guardians of Girl Children aged below 10 years
schemes.financial_assistance: High government-backed compound interest rate (~8.2% p.a.) with full tax exemption (EEE: Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) under Section 80C.
eligibility_criteria: Account can be opened by parents/guardians for a girl child before she reaches 10 years of age.
Maximum 2 accounts per family (or 3 in case of twin/triplet girl birth in first/subsequent order).
benefits: Minimum deposit of ₹250 up to ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
50% partial withdrawal allowed for higher education after girl turns 18 or completes 10th standard; full maturity upon 21 years or marriage after 18.
schemes.application_process: Open account at any Post Office branch or authorized public/private commercial banks.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Adult Women from Poor / Deprived Households without LPG connection
schemes.financial_assistance: Deposit-free new LPG connection, free first LPG refill cylinder, and free domestic gas stove; ongoing targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg refill.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an adult woman (aged 18+) belonging to eligible vulnerable category (SC/ST, PMAY beneficiary, AAY, most backward classes, tea garden tribes, forest dwellers) or declared under 14-point declaration.
No other LPG connection exists in the same household.
benefits: Zero initial cost for gas stove and regulator.
Protection from indoor air pollution caused by firewood/coal burning.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card with proof of address
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or submit application form at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).

schemes.title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Girls and Women of all age groups
schemes.financial_assistance: Guaranteed fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly for a 2-year tenure on deposits up to ₹2,00,000.
eligibility_criteria: Can be opened by a woman for herself or by a guardian on behalf of a minor girl child.
Deposit amount ranges from minimum ₹1,000 to maximum ₹2,00,000 in multiples of ₹100.
benefits: High guaranteed return of 7.5% per annum.
Partial withdrawal of up to 40% of balance permitted after one year from opening.
Full maturity payout after 2 years.
schemes.application_process: Open account across any Department of Posts branch (Post Office) or authorized Scheduled Commercial Banks.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: EWS, LIG, and Middle-Income Families (MIG) residing in statutory urban areas
schemes.financial_assistance: Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) up to ₹1.80 Lakh on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for houses valued up to ₹35 Lakh; or ₹2.50 Lakh direct assistance for Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC).
eligibility_criteria: Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India in the name of any family member.
Income Ceiling: EWS up to ₹3 Lakh/yr, LIG ₹3 to ₹6 Lakh/yr, MIG ₹6 to ₹9 Lakh/yr.
House ownership must be in the name of the female head or joint ownership with spouse.
benefits: Affordable all-weather pucca housing with basic civic amenities (water, sanitation, electricity, kitchen).
Substantial relief on home loan EMI via upfront credit-linked interest subsidy.
documents_required: Aadhaar Cards of all family members
Affidavit of not owning a pucca house
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmay-urban.gov.in or through Urban Local Body (Municipal Corporation / Municipality) Citizen Service Centres.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Houseless rural households and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses (Awaas+ list)
schemes.financial_assistance: Direct grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP districts; additional ₹12,000 for toilet under Swachh Bharat and 90/95 days of unskilled MGNREGA wages.
eligibility_criteria: Beneficiary must be listed in SECC 2011 / Awaas+ survey and verified by Gram Sabha.
Must not own a pucca house or motorized 3/4 wheeler, agricultural equipment, or government job.
benefits: Direct installment-based DBT linked to geo-tagged physical construction stages (plinth, lintel, roof, completion).
Clean LPG connection under Ujjwala and electricity under Saubhagya.
schemes.application_process: Selection is done transparently via Gram Sabha from Awaas+ list; status tracking via AwaasSoft portal at pmayg.nic.in.

schemes.title: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All Rural Households across India
schemes.financial_assistance: 100% government-funded piped water infrastructure providing 55 litres of potable water per person per day (lpcd) via Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC).
eligibility_criteria: All residential households in rural villages without functional tap water connections.
benefits: Safe and adequate drinking water delivered right to home, reducing waterborne diseases and drudgery of fetching water.
Community water testing kits (Field Test Kits - FTKs) provided to 5 women in each village.
documents_required: Village Residence Proof / Gram Panchayat household registry
schemes.application_process: Implemented at village level by Village Water & Sanitation Committees (VWSC) / Pani Samitis. Track progress on ejalshakti.gov.in.

schemes.title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Urban, Peri-Urban, and Rural Street Vendors and Hawkers
schemes.financial_assistance: Tranche 1: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1 yr tenure). Tranche 2: Up to ₹20,000 upon timely repayment. Tranche 3: Up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and ₹1,200/yr cashback on digital transactions.
eligibility_criteria: Street vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
Vendors left out of survey who have been issued Letter of Recommendation (LoR) by ULB or Town Vending Committee (TVC).
benefits: Collateral-free micro-credit enabling vendors to resume and scale daily livelihoods.
7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account quarterly.
Cashback incentives for digital payments made via UPI QR codes.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending / ID Card / LoR
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, via PM SVANidhi mobile app, or through CSC/Banking Correspondents.

schemes.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Traditional Artisans and Craftspeople engaged in 18 identified trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Cobblers, Masons, Tailors, Weavers, etc.)
schemes.financial_assistance: Collateral-free enterprise loan up to ₹1,00,000 (Tranche 1 at 5% interest rate) and ₹2,00,000 (Tranche 2); ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern toolkits; ₹500/day stipend during 5-7 days basic skill training.
eligibility_criteria: Artisan working with hands and tools in one of the 18 specified trades.
Minimum age 18 years; one member per family.
Must not have availed similar government credit schemes (PMEGP, MUDRA) in the past 5 years.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card providing formal national recognition.
Skill upgradation, modern digital toolkit grant, concessional credit, and brand marketing support.
schemes.application_process: Register with biometric verification at any CSC; verified via 3-tier validation (Gram Panchayat / ULB -> District Committee -> Screening Committee).

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Non-Corporate, Non-Farm Small/Micro Entrepreneurs (Shopkeepers, Traders, Manufacturers, Service Units)
schemes.financial_assistance: Collateral-free loans across 4 tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh for past successful borrowers).
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for non-farm income generating activities.
No prior default with any bank or financial institution.
benefits: Zero collateral requirement and zero processing fees for Shishu and Kishore loans.
Mudra RuPay card for flexible working capital withdrawals.
documents_required: Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
schemes.application_process: Apply online via Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or Jan Samarth (jansamarth.in) or walk into any commercial bank branch.

schemes.title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / KVIC
schemes.target_beneficiaries: New Entrepreneurs Setting up Micro-Enterprises in Manufacturing & Services
schemes.financial_assistance: Margin Money Subsidy of 15% to 35% on project costs up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing units and ₹20 Lakh for service units.
eligibility_criteria: Any individual aged 18+; at least 8th standard pass for manufacturing projects > ₹10 Lakh and service projects > ₹5 Lakh.
Higher subsidy (35% rural / 25% urban) for Special Categories (SC, ST, OBC, Women, Ex-Servicemen, Divyangjan, NER).
benefits: Substantial government capital subsidy deposited into escrow account, converting to grant upon 3 years of successful operation.
schemes.application_process: Apply online on the KVIC PMEGP e-Portal at kviconline.gov.in.

schemes.title: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance / SIDBI
schemes.target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, and Women Entrepreneurs setting up Greenfield Enterprises
schemes.financial_assistance: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield projects in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors.
eligibility_criteria: Borrower must be SC/ST and/or Woman entrepreneur above 18 years of age.
In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST/Woman entrepreneur.
benefits: Facilitates access to commercial bank financing with handholding support via SIDBI portal.
schemes.application_process: Apply directly on standupmitra.in or through bank branches.

schemes.title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (DPIIT)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Early-Stage DPIIT-Recognized Startups
schemes.financial_assistance: Grants up to ₹20 Lakh for Proof of Concept (PoC), prototype development, product trials; and debt/convertible debentures up to ₹50 Lakh for commercialization and market entry.
eligibility_criteria: A DPIIT-recognized startup incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application.
Startup must have a business idea to develop a product or service with market fit and scope of scaling.
Should not have received more than ₹10 Lakh of monetary support under any other Central/State Govt scheme.
benefits: Crucial early-stage funding enabling innovative technology startups to reach investor-ready scale.
schemes.application_process: Apply online at seedfund.startupindia.gov.in choosing up to 3 sector-specific incubators.

schemes.title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Rural Adult Households Willing to Do Unskilled Manual Work
schemes.financial_assistance: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per financial year at statutory state-notified wage rates (~₹230 - ₹374 per day) paid via Aadhaar-Based Payment System (ABPS).
eligibility_criteria: Adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
Must reside in the local Gram Panchayat area.
benefits: Statutory legal guarantee of wage employment within 15 days of application, or daily unemployment allowance in lieu thereof.
Creation of durable rural infrastructure (water harvesting, village roads, pond renovation).
schemes.application_process: Apply for MGNREGA Job Card at local Gram Panchayat office or online on nrega.nic.in.

schemes.title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Students from OBC, EBC, and DNT categories studying in Top Class Schools / Colleges
schemes.financial_assistance: Full scholarship grant: Up to ₹75,000/yr for Class 9-10 and up to ₹1,25,000/yr for Class 11-12 covering tuition and hostel fees.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must belong to OBC / EBC / DNT categories.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh from all sources.
Studying in designated Top-Class Schools across India.
benefits: Comprehensive financial coverage enabling underprivileged meritorious students to access premier secondary schooling.
schemes.application_process: Apply online via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in.

schemes.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education / AICTE
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Girl Students Admitted to 1st Year Degree / Diploma Courses in AICTE Approved Technical Institutions
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college tuition fees, computer purchase, books, and equipment.
eligibility_criteria: Female student admitted to 1st year (or 2nd year lateral entry) of technical degree/diploma in an AICTE approved college.
Family income must be less than ₹8 Lakh per annum.
Maximum 2 girl children per family.
benefits: Direct ₹50,000 annual scholarship deposited via DBT to empower girls in engineering, IT, and technical fields.
documents_required: College Admission Letter & Tuition Fee Receipt
schemes.application_process: Submit application annually through National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in.

schemes.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled (Divyang) Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education / AICTE
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Specially-Abled Students (Disability >= 40%) Pursuing Technical Degree / Diploma
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college tuition fees, assistive devices, and books.
eligibility_criteria: Student with disability of not less than 40% admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma in AICTE approved institution.
Family income not more than ₹8 Lakh per annum.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹50,000/year to support divyang students in higher technical education.
schemes.application_process: Apply online via the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

schemes.title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Regular Students Pursuing Higher Education after Class 12
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level via direct DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Scored above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 Board exams.
Pursuing regular full-time degree courses in recognized colleges/universities.
Total parental annual income not exceeding ₹4.50 Lakh.
benefits: Direct scholarship support covering university tuition, books, and living expenses throughout higher education.
schemes.application_process: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with board roll number.

schemes.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of School Education & Literacy)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Economically Weaker Students studying in Classes 9 to 12 in Govt/Govt-Aided Schools
schemes.financial_assistance: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 through Class 12 via direct DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Studying in regular State Govt, Govt-aided, or Local body school with at least 55% marks in Class 7/8.
Parental income from all sources not more than ₹3.50 Lakh per annum.
Must qualify the State-level NMMSS selection test.
benefits: Arrests secondary school dropouts and encourages economically weaker students to complete secondary education.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) after clearing state selection examination.

schemes.title: PM Internship Scheme (PMIS 2024-25)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Youth aged 21 to 24 Years Seeking Real-World Corporate Work Experience
schemes.financial_assistance: Monthly stipend of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 by Govt via DBT + ₹500 by Company CSR) for 12 months, plus a one-time grant of ₹6,000 for incidentals.
eligibility_criteria: Youth aged 21 to 24 years who have passed Class 10, Class 12, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Graduation (BA, BSc, BCom, BCA, BBA, BPharma).
Must NOT be engaged in full-time employment or full-time education.
Family income must not exceed ₹8 Lakh/year and no family member in regular government service.
Graduates from IITs, IIMs, IISERs, CA/CMA are not eligible.
benefits: 12 months hands-on internship in top 500 companies in India (Tata, Reliance, L&T, HDFC, Infosys, Mahindra, etc.).
Insurance coverage under PMJJBY and PMSBY provided by the government.
schemes.application_process: Register online at the PM Internship Portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in) and apply for up to 5 internship opportunities.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / NSDC
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Unemployed Youth, School/College Dropouts seeking Industry-Relevant Skill Training
schemes.financial_assistance: 100% free skill training, assessment, and government certification with monetary reward/stipend and job placement assistance.
eligibility_criteria: Indian national aged 15 to 45 years.
School/college dropout or unemployed youth possessing an Aadhaar card and bank account.
benefits: Short-term training and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) in Industry 4.0 courses (AI, Robotics, Drone Technology, Coding, 3D Printing, Electric Vehicles).
NSQF-aligned certificate recognized nationally and internationally.
schemes.application_process: Enroll on the Skill India Digital Hub (skillindiadigital.gov.in) or visit nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK).
